description: Keep a VPS whose cancellation was scheduled with type end_of_period: the scheduled cancellation is removed, the server stays active and renews as usual. No money moves (end_of_period never refunds). An immediate cancellation cannot be undone — the VM is destroyed at once. get_vps_status shows `cancellation` {type, cancel_at, can_undo}. Requires: token + a scheduled end_of_period cancellation. Typical error: 409 nothing_to_undo.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: undo_cancel
title: Undo a scheduled cancellation
